The rook on d7 and queen on d8 are the heart of Black's defense. After Black's last move Rxd7, White has a devastating forcing sequence: **e7+** lures the queen away from defending, forcing Qxe7. The key lesson: **When your opponent's pieces are cramped and you have a forcing check that attacks multiple pieces, look for sacrifices that use tempo (check) to win material by force rather than trading evenly.**
